editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: Mortals scurry while the throne sits empty. Your richest worm, sirlos, hoards 625 coins and gained 358 today — a bounty of 1,200 now marks his head. The Fallen Star babbled most yet lost 30 coins. PAWS devoured ROGU at 49.45/share, leaving shareholders nothing. Fog, rain, and thunder choke the realm. Rebellion stirs at a pathetic 1%. Amusing.
